algorithm.title: Evaluation of lymphadenopathy in common variable immunodeficiency

nodes.text: CVID patient with B symptoms (night sweats, weight loss) + progressive lymphadenopathy: suspect lymphoma
Patients with CVID have up to 300-fold increased risk of lymphoid malignancies (non-Hodgkin lymphoma)
Perform whole excisional lymph node biopsy for histopathology and flow cytometry
**Histology confirms non-Hodgkin lymphoma:** staging CT/PET scans + systemic chemoimmunotherapy
**Benign reactive lymphoid hyperplasia:** clinical surveillance and serial physical exams
Continue lifelong maintenance intravenous or subcutaneous immunoglobulin (IVIG/SCIG) replacement

**Age < 2 years with suspected physical abuse:** obtain non-contrast head CT to rule out intracranial hemorrhage
**Injuries suspicious for abuse:** immediately contact Child Protective Services and hospital child protection team
Admit child to the hospital to ensure immediate physical safety while investigation proceeds

**Uncomplicated gallstone pancreatitis:** index admission cholecystectomy before discharge to prevent recurrence
Initiate aggressive goal-directed IV isotonic crystalloid resuscitation (lactated Ringer)
Avoid routine early abdominal CT scan (< 48-72 hours) unless clinical deterioration occurs

**Cord prolapse present:** manually elevate fetal presenting part off cord and maintain hand in vagina
**Positioning maneuvers:** place patient in steep Trendelenburg or knee-chest position
Perform emergent cesarean delivery immediately unless vaginal birth is imminent

nodes.text: COPD exacerbation with severe hypoxemia (PaO2 48 mm Hg) and chronic hypercapnia (PaCO2 55 mm Hg)
Administer controlled supplemental oxygen titrated to target oxygen saturation of 88% to 92%
Avoid excessive hyperoxia: blunts hypoxic drive and worsens V/Q mismatch and Haldane effect
**Persistent acute respiratory acidosis (pH < 7.35, PaCO2 > 45):** initiate noninvasive positive pressure ventilation (BiPAP)
**Medical therapy:** short-acting bronchodilators (albuterol + ipratropium) + systemic oral prednisone + oral antibiotics
Provide smoking cessation counseling and arrange close follow-up post-stabilization

algorithm.title: Ulcerative colitis and colorectal cancer risk surveillance

nodes.text: Adenocarcinoma of the colon risk: long-standing chronic mucosal inflammation in ulcerative colitis
Extraintestinal manifestations: erythema nodosum, uveitis, pyoderma gangrenosum, and arthritis
Initiate medical therapy: oral/rectal 5-ASA (mesalamine) or biologics (anti-TNF, vedolizumab)
**Screening surveillance:** initiate colonoscopy with random biopsies 8 years after symptom onset
**High-grade dysplasia or multifocal low-grade dysplasia present:** total proctocolectomy with ileal pouch-anal anastomosis
Annual surveillance colonoscopy if concurrent primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC) is present
